stem: How does inflammatory enthesitis typically differ from mechanical apophysitis in relation to activity?

options.text: Enthesitis improves with activity, whereas apophysitis worsens
Enthesitis is only found at the tibial tuberosity
Enthesitis never occurs at the same sites as apophysitis
Enthesitis only occurs after sports injury

explanation: Enthesitis is an inflammatory process that tends to cause morning stiffness and improves with movement, whereas mechanical apophysitis is aggravated by activity.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because inflammatory enthesitis typically causes pain and stiffness that ease with activity, while mechanical apophysitis is usually worse with use.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because enthesitis can occur at multiple insertion sites, not just the tibial tuberosity.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because significant morning stiffness is more typical of inflammatory conditions such as enthesitis than of mechanical apophysitis.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because enthesitis and apophysitis can involve similar anatomical sites, which can make them difficult to distinguish clinically.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because enthesitis is an inflammatory condition and is not limited to occurring only after sports injury.

source.hint: Think about how movement affects inflammatory versus mechanical pain.
